definitions: The act of coming or going back to a previous place or state.
A report or form submitted to the government, especially for taxes.
The act of giving, sending, or putting something back.
The proceeds or profit from an activity or venture.
examples: His return to the office was unexpected.
The investment yielded a good return.
She filed her tax return last week.
The return of the book to the library was overdue.
They celebrated the safe return of the explorers.
